description: AGSC-06-36 as amended for 1.1: Policy is derived, where the authored file states none, as the absolute URL of the disclosure page that site.security_policy declares and otherwise, as in 1.0, of /legal/ where that route is emitted. Derivation, case by case, with the clause structure of build-0013 (Expires is the build instant plus 364 days: 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z + 364 d = 2026-12-31T00:00:00Z; derived fields follow the authored ones, in the order Expires, Canonical, Policy). (1) declared: the declared page wins over /legal/ even though /legal/ is emitted. (2) default: no declared page, /legal/ emitted: the 1.0 bytes of build-0013. (3) declared-without-legal: the declared page is used although /legal/ is not emitted. (4) authored-policy-kept: the authored file states Policy, which is published verbatim in the authored order, and no Policy is derived. (5) neither: no declared page and no /legal/: no Policy line.

cases.name: declared
cases.text:
Contact: mailto:security@a.example
Expires: 2026-12-31T00:00:00Z
Canonical: https://a.example/.well-known/security.txt
Policy: https://a.example/disclosure/
